abstract: The battery is the most crucial part of a car. Therefore, for best operation, each battery must be restored to its full potential. Lead Acid batteries are typically used in automobile batteries, and they need to undergo meticulous inspection to perform well under all circumstances. Consequently, a more organized battery control system is required to permit continuous monitoring of the battery's functioning. When it comes to batteries, the SoH (State of Health), SoC (State of Charging), and SoD (State of Discharging) are the most important features. Such parameters can be calculated using a number of cogent ways. However, as the battery's components, surroundings, and load will all have an impact on the parameters, such methods cannot produce precise results. A battery that has been overcharged releases gases like oxygen and hydrogen. In addition to attempting to detect the escape of various gases from the battery under overload situations, the Battery Management System (BMS) uses sensors and an STM controller to display the voltage, current, and temperature of the battery. Through the use of IOT and cloud technologies, this study focused on the detection of hydrogen gas released by batteries.

articleTitle: A Millimeter Wave Filter for 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Bandpass filters, which only transmit frequencies that fall inside the transmission band and reject all other frequencies, are necessary for wireless communication systems. As 5G is set to be implemented, there will be a greater need for filters that operate in new frequency ranges. In 2022, the initial use is anticipated. The two key standards for filters that are used to build mobile applications are size and performance. With a repetition range of 26–28 GHz, the passband channel is designed in this proposal, simulated, and constructed. For downconversion of mmWave signals to microwave frequencies between 2 and 18 GHz, this channel can be employed as the front end of the apparatus. The size and efficiency of channels must be taken into account when planning new portable communications applications. Small, high-performance filters made by merging two components can be used in future mmWave applications like 5G. High-quality channels with minimal imprint are preferred for mmWave applications like 5G.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Based Research For Financial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Over the past few years, there have been constant new innovations that have impacted everyone in every aspect of life. Computer-based intelligence innovation is one such development that is capable of changing the entire planet. Artificial intelligence refers to computer programming that can mimic human behavior and think similarly to humans. In the present day and age, the bulk of corporate capabilities use simulated intelligence. The financial administrations sector is one business competency where the fusion of computer-based intelligence is happening quickly. The majority of core financial functions, including risk assessment, stock trading, and credit loaning cycle, are being replaced by artificial intelligence. In this review, related writing distributions were evaluated using a foundational content examination technique. A few buzzwords are used to search for financial and artificial intelligence articles, such as corporate finance and artificial intelligence, computerized finance and artificial intelligence, and so forth. Associations all around the world have been seen as using artificial intelligence to spot irregularities. It is used to lay out optimum venture strategy. Algorithmic exchanging, programmers that coordinate data with respect to shifting business sector aspects and cost levels by using restrictive calculations to make robotized exchanging swiftly, is another application of computer-based intelligence in security.

articleTitle: 5G Dual Band Microstrip patch antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This work proposes a dual band microstrip fed patch antenna suitable for 5G mobile networks access. The antenna resonates at 28GHz and 38GHz frequency and requires large infrastructure for implementation. Dual band response is achieved by etching a semi-circular slot in the main radiator and introducing another resonator close to this slot which radiates electromagnetic energy. The proposed antenna has a satisfactory gain at both frequency bands and shows omnidirectional radiations and is useful for mobile users and is exclusively used for microwave technology applications.

articleTitle: A Survey: Faults, Fault-tolerance & Fault Detection Techniques in WSN
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Present modern world become more automated, forecast-able and accurate by using wireless sensor network. To make a WSN more undependable and reliable, researchers have to make advance research on each and every domain of WSN, mainly on fault tolerant techniques. This paper thoroughly investigate the mechanism to achieve a fault tolerant network. The prime focus of this paper is to make understanding about faults, failures and its classification and detection in the network and explain the techniques to detection of fault, prevention of fault and recovery of the fault in the sensor network, these are the very crucial parameters of a fault tolerant network.

articleTitle: Power Loss Mitigation in Distribution System using Modified Firefly Algorithm Compared with Bat Algorithm by Compensating DSTATCOM Size
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The intention of this work is to reduce the power losses of the distribution power systems by optimizing the DSTATCOM size. A comparative analysis has been made between novel Modified Firefly Algorithm (MFA) and Bat Algorithm (BA) for mitigating the power losses in Radial Distribution System (RDS). Modified Firefly Algorithm (MFA) and Bat Algorithm (BA) are utilized for compensating DSTATCOM sizes in the radial distribution system. 14 samples total were used in this study, and the sample size was determined using Gpower for two groups. Based on the results obtained MFA produces better results than BA in terms of power loss reduction. The significant value (Two-tailed) obtained is 0.566 (p>0.05, statistically insignificant). MFA based optimization method provides significantly better power loss reduction (134.09kW) than BA based method (139.42kW).

articleTitle: IoT and ML based Irrigation System using KNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Agriculture is an important sector that contributes significantly to the improvement of the social and economic conditions of every nation around the globe. Water is essential to life and also represents a valuable resource for agricultural production. Emerging trends in agriculture have the goals of maximizing crop yields while minimizing harm to the environment and contributing to the development of sustainable agricultural practices (12). The level of moisture in the soil is the single most important factor in determining crop productivity; insufficient moisture leads to a reduction in yield and ultimately the death of the plants. Wasted water and illnesses of the roots can be caused by an abundance of water. It is necessary to apply the appropriate amount of water at the optimal moment in order to achieve maximum crop output. The IOT and ML will be used to construct an automated watering system in the proposed project. The system is broken down into three stages: (1) building the circuit and installing the sensors, (2) involves observing the sensor data and determining the current level of soil moisture, (3) involves determining whether or not to turn the motor on or off based on the type of crop being grown. The data from the sensors is saved on the server, and the system provides data from the sensors in real time. The IOT (IoT) assists in the implementation of Wireless Sensor Networks, and ML can manage the most efficient use of scarce water resources for farming by analyzing the data that is readily available.

articleTitle: Predicting Ratings of Trending Youtube Videos using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: YouTube is a global platform on which its users can upload their videos and have interactive review of other users through built-in features such as like, comment, rate, share, upload content, and save. A few videos which have tremendous number of views and likes over an explicit span of time become overly favored and such videos are known as ‘Trending YouTube Videos’. This research suggests predicting whether ratings for a Trending YouTube video are disabled. The sensitivity of a video’s content can be determined by its YouTube ratings. It is implied that a video has restricted or sensitive content and is not intended for children if there is no rating, i.e., ratings disabled. Research is based on data from 999 YouTube videos that were trending within a specific time period. Statistics consists of the number of views, likes, dislikes and comment counts, the research was performed using the following models of Machine Learning namely Random Forest, Decision Tree, Support Vector Machine, Logistic Regression, and K-Nearest Neighbor.

articleTitle: Various Threats and Attack on Cloud Computing: A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In recent decades, software and its services have played a vital role in everyone’s lives. Because of the internet’s phenomenal growth and use all over the world, data stored in various parts of the territory is linked together for better availability. The availability of resources and services is achieved through cloud computing technologies. Cloud computing allows multiple organizations to access the resources with increased infrastructure at a low cost, and the estimation of the cost depends on how much computational power is being used. In a Cloud environment, the availability of resources is attained through efficient load balancing algorithms. The data from various organizations is stored in different servers of the cloud, and it can be accessed through the cloud service providers. Reliable and secured storage of data in the cloud is one of the main challenges of the cloud environment. This paper looks at all of the different kinds of security problems in cloud computing.

articleTitle: A Structured Investigation of Network Security Strategies and its Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Organizations can utilize big data to spread information over a network, analyses vast amounts of complex data, and find hidden trends and correlations. The deployment of a platform that is both effective and secure is required since the information that moves across the networking of an institution is frequently important. Entire network has thus been promoted to the early stages of evaluation in the context of big data. computer protection technologies are created to recognize and thwart possible attacks in a real-time environment. must manage a significant volume of data that is both complex and varied. Unfortunately, because these systems are usually created using outdated techniques, securing vast volumes of information can be difficult. In this post, we’ll mostly talk about information protection for massive volumes of data and network security solutions. We start by talking about the variables that affect network security design in the Big Data environment. Then, we’ll talk about a few big data solutions that provide network-wide data protection in addition to current study findings.

articleTitle: A Study on Artificial Intelligence Based Automatic Vehicle Navigation
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The term "artificial intelligence" refers to a machine intelligence tool which opens up vast possibilities for the "smart industrial revolution." It makes it easy to gather the relevant information and facts, to recognize the alternatives, to select from the alternatives, to take some actions, to make choices, to review the decision, to make some intelligent predictions. The integration of low latency connectivity, resilient, high-speed as well as AI and the IoT technologies will allow the shift towards completely smart Autonomous Vehicle (AV) which highlight the complimentary between the digital knowledge and the real world for industry 4.0. The primary purpose of the study is to investigate in depth a number of automated guided vehicle (AGV) system designs as well as variety of approaches to their implementation. This research presents an overview of the Automated Guided Vehicle System (AGVS) technology, reviews recent technological breakthroughs, and details certain formulations in order to control the traffic within industrial work spaces. A comprehensive assessment of the existing body of previous research served as the methodology for this research. The findings of this study indicate that human error is responsible for ninety percent of all car accidents, and that the best drivers are about ten times superior than the average driver on the road. The safety of automated vehicles is very important, and users are demanding an acceptable risk level that is one thousand times lower.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence and Mixed Reality Technology for Interactive Display of Images in Smart Area
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The adoption of immersive technologies has altered the traditional shopping experience. We report the results of a study that set out to see how people react to a 17 million artificial intelligence (AI) embedded mixed reality (MR) exhibit in a shopping and entertainment complex that brings together cutting-edge technology and traditional retail. Our research shows that MR enjoyment, spatial immersion, and consumers’ perceptions of unique experiences are all positively impacted by the quality of AI (i.e. voice synthesis and recognition using machine learning) connected with an augmented object. All of these things work together to pique consumers’ interest and elicit favorable reactions, including the desire to make a purchase and the want to tell others about the experience. In conclusion, this research demonstrates that there are new opportunities to increase customer engagement thanks to interactive AI and MR technology.

articleTitle: Medical Insurance Virtual Assistant: Vaidya
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: You must eat healthily if you want to live a long and happy life. Many times, individuals are unaware of all the possible diagnoses, therapies, or signs of a certain illness. For youngsters, it is quite difficult to acquire a doctor's visit for any medical conditions, manage phone calls, for users with the condition travel to the institution in real for a time-consuming test. By offering relevant advice on leading a healthy lifestyle, healthcare/medical chatbots may help with these kinds of issues. The idea is to use neural networks to build a medical chatbot that can offer information, identify diseases, and provide basic illness information as well as when and where to seek medical advice. NLP technology, which enables users to express their worries about any condition as well as their health, is the foundation of the success of medical chatbots. Without physically would be at the clinic, the user may utilize a chatbot to ask any personal questions about health care. Through a medical chat-bot, this will increase access to health records while lowering the cost of healthcare. The program development strategy calls for consumer sentiment analysis.

articleTitle: Frail Older Healthcare Tracking System
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: By measuring self-health and giving professionals data for diagnostic testing and better patient advice, remote health monitoring devices assist individuals in managing and monitoring their highest priorities and earlier. Our research intends to create a prototype for geriatric health monitoring utilizing sensors and alarm messages sent to physicians or families in the event that vital signs are aberrant. A Tracking system, an Arduino Nano, a node MCU, and a display are among the elements of this smart monitoring system. Other sensors include a pulse/heartbeat detector, a GSR for activity recognition, a temperature, an inertial transmitter for detection and tracking, and a gyroscope for step measuring. The Arduino receives data from the sensors. The microcontroller receives such sensor readings from the Arduino and transmits them. The sensor readings may then be saved in the cloud thanks to the data transmission from the nodeMCU. These data may also be shown graphically using MATLAB on Thing speak, a cloud-based platform. The vitals graph on the Cloud server has been presented using the monitoring device’s precise readings of the vitals, which have been successfully programmed to send out alert message within abnormal ranges of values (smart monitoring). The limitation of our study is that the size of device is larger than a portable one and it has to be fitted into a shorter enclosure for the comfort of the patient in addition to monitoring their patient’s condition.By always wearing the gadget, you can maintain your health. However, a more refined version of this study could make it easier for patients to monitor and control their health.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based Topic-level Examination of Social Media
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Due to its superior processing power in fields like text, picture, and audio processing, deep learning (DL) is becoming more and more popular. The exponential growth and extensive accessibility of digital social media (SM) make the evaluation of this data challenging, if not impossible, using conventional methodologies and technology. It has been determined that DL is a suitable answer to this issue. After the enormous work put into SM analytics, we provide a taxonomy-focused assessment of the DL architectures employed in this research (SMA). However, rather than focusing on a technical explanation, this work aims to explain the SMA-related problems utilizing DL-based remedies. We also discuss the potential and difficulties for DL research in the future, including scalability, heterogeneity, and multimodality.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of MERVH (Motion and Energy Regulating Vibration Harvester) for different human activities
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In this paper the numerical simulation of the MERVH is presented. The simulation is mainly intended to investigate the effectiveness of MERVH for human activities such as slow walking, fast walking, jumping, jogging, and running. The MATLAB-Simulink is used to numerically analyze the theoretical model. The results revealed that the MERVH provides average power output varying from 0.04 W to 0.19 W and peak power of 4.41 W. The maximum power was obtained in case of running motion. The MERVH is found to be useful in powering wearable devices and operating the medical sensors.

articleTitle: Imep: Influence Maximization on Social Media with the Impact of E-Commerce Products
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Friends and family have a large influence on consumer purchasing decisions. Furthermore, many internet users prefer to wait for early adopter reviews before making a purchase decision in order to reduce the risk of adopting a new product. E-commerce corporations actively construct web-based social networks that enable users to share their experiences by submitting evaluations, evaluating other people’s assessments, and talking with genuine members. They act as a starting point for online customers and a means of directing them to other shopping sites. E-commerce companies have recently begun to collect data on consumer social interactions on their websites, with the potential goal of understanding and exploiting social influence in customer purchase decisions to improve customer relationship management and boost sales. This article proposed influence maximization on Social media with the impact of the E-Commerce Products (IMEP) framework. We collect dig and yelp datasets for finding the Social Influence (SI) for E-Commerce Products (EP). The IMEP framework utilized the United Community Recognition algorithm (UCR) to find influence maximization (IM) accuracy. The experimental results are discussed with greedy clustering and the performance measures are compared.

articleTitle: Using AIG in Verilog HDL, Autonomous Testing in a Family of Wien Bridge Cross Transducers
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This research reports on the software configuration of automated fault detection and recognition using neural networks (ANNs) in a class of 13.6 cross actuators. According to the findings, the suggested flaw detector is ideal for integrating knowledge into the devices in a way that is living thing. The seven often recurring defects in a batch of these sensors are directly determined by the automated fault tester that is being demonstrated. In this study, the suggested automated defect detector is trained using an ANN-based binary class system. If any of the mistakes occurs, logic Programming is applied to define a high or ”1” output, whereas the returning is calculated whether the other 6 failures occurred lowest or ”0”. The input outputs from the Or CAD programme are used as incoming signal, and indeed the produced train parameters, i.e., amplitude and biased of the artificial neural tool of Math, have been used.

Author Keywords: Wheatstone bridge and or CAD Program

articleTitle: A Case on Decentralized use of Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Over the last twenty years, the technological world has seen a radical shift that calls for more robust and efficient data security solutions. This is a common use case for blockchains. It is a technology that enables mentoring (P2P) asset exchanges alone without requirement for a centralized authority to regulate and manage, i.e., a single node. It works by combining several technology including hashing, acceptance methods, and digital signatures. With the help of each of these technologies, a system that allows simple activity recording and offers security and transparency may be developed. The view on company functioning in regards to transparency and decentralization has been completely modified by crypto currencies. In addition to being the foundation of the crypto currency market, which has had a significant influence on the world economics, blockchain has the potential to revolutionise a number of industries, including medicine, finance, social care, and schooling. This research intends to explore the crypto currency construction, its properties, such as anonymity, safety, and visibility, and the numerous fields in the contemporary world that may utilize chain to address current issues.

articleTitle: Employing Deep Learning Algorithm to Identify Diabetic Retinopathy
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Blindness can result from the disease known as diabetic retinopathy, which destroys the retinal blood vessels. Typically, colored fundus injections are used to identify this fatal condition. Taking into account the importance of machine learning algorithms for disease identification, developed a convolutional neural network Visual Geometry Group-16 model to predict diabetic retinopathy illnesses, allowing people to act quickly in terms of treatment. The experimental photographs are divided into four stages: mild, moderate, severe, and proliferative retinopathy. At this stage, micro aneurysms first appear in mild, non-proliferative retinopathy. In moderate non-proliferative retinal disease, a small number of blood vessels that nourish the retina are blocked as the condition worsens. More blood vessels get blocked in severe non-proliferative retinopathy, reducing blood flow to the retina's surface. These regions tell the body to develop new blood vessels so that the area can be nourished. In the advanced stage of proliferative retinal disease, the retina's signals for nutrition cause the development of new blood vessels. Proliferative retinopathy is the name of this condition. These brand-new blood vessels are atypical and delicate. The symptoms of vision loss are not brought on by these blood vessels alone. Since they have fragile and thin walls, blood can leak out and seriously impair eyesight. The results of the studies show that the suggested model may attain an accuracy of 91.06% with a loss in testing of 0.058. This proposed methodology gives a direct route to a deep learning-based diabetic retinopathy prediction system that can be used widely for future purposes.

articleTitle: Gesture Controlled Robotics arm using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The combination of mechanical, electronic, informative, computer science and many other engineering that aims to replicate the behavior of humans, or to make tasks automated and easier is called Robotics. Robots can be used to perform many different types of tasks under various environments. Most of these environments are those that can be lethal to humans like those of radioactive radiations. Other environments include those that are beyond the reach of humans such as far into space or deep underground. There are tasks like carrying a moving a lever up and down twenty thousand times a day, which is not possible for a human. This is where a robot steps in. A robot can go to far off space like Mercury and send high resolution pictures back here to our planet earth. A robot can go deep inside our earth, study the soil and send back data. A robot can work on nuclear power plants with radiations have zero to negligible effect on it. A robot can be used to do automated tasks without getting tired. In this paper, our aim is to make a gesture-controlled arm robot that is better, and an improvement over the existing system.

articleTitle: Hybrid Soft Computing based Approach for Ageing in Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Proposed Approach is a collection of methods for handling a certain class of complicated issues that call for the usage of intelligent software computers. For computational complexity issues, the merger of Pattern Recognition with Soft Context of online like Rnns has demonstrated a bright future, giving birth to strategies and systems with great performance and speed. Utilization of this fusion approach greatly improved the quality of detecting faces in a face - recognition workflow. DCNs are used in our hybrid algorithm, which combines CNN and LSTM, and they focus on the idea of optimizing the face's deep features. Results from our suggested system's testing upon that CACD datasets are quite encouraging and supportive

articleTitle: An Innovative Internet Of Things (IoT) Computing-Based Health Monitoring System With the Aid of Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The community health area comprises a massive amount of information, and particular approaches are used to handle that information. One of the most common approaches is handling as well as processing. This technique forecasts the likely consequences of cardiovascular disease. The outcome of this method is to predict the preceding heart illness. The job controls IOT using a sensor (a pulse sensor to monitor pulses) and Arduino, and the results may be seen on a sequential screen. IFTTT is used to analyze sensor readings in Google Sheets, which are subsequently converted into CSV go-like data. The datasets used are classified according to treatment parameters, in addition to being used for data preparation and testing. This technique evaluates those parameters using the information preparation order method. With AI computations and categorization work. The dataset is first dissected, examined, and screened, after which the gathered data is processed in Python programming using Machine Learning Algorithms, namely Decision Tree Algorithm with Random Backwoods Classification Algorithm. SVM (Support vector machine) produces the best results in terms of detecting heart disease. As a result, the suggested paradigm is shown to be a reliable one for predicting past heart disease. The suggested hardware and software technology assists patients in predicting cardiac disease in its initial stages.

articleTitle: A detailed research of the defect Prediction, Preventive Measures, and Recuperation effect of Big Data Analytics in Wireless Connections – A Multivariable Logistic Calculation
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Many firms and sectors have been able to embrace digital for improving corporate operations and help in achieving the overall goals thanks to the present economic climate and competitive landscape. Since more people are using mobile devices, the web, social networks, as well as other e-commerce services, there is a growing avalanche of data that is being exchanged between people, businesses, and authorities. The exponential growth of this trend makes adequate wireless network provision necessary. The rising use of information and data has led to a number of issues, including call dropouts for mobile users and limited bandwidth for internet users, among other things. Implementing tools to comprehend failure predictions, mitigation, and restoration on the network is so crucial.As a result, the focus of this study is on examining how big data analysis can shield wireless networks from these failures and assist in processing massive amounts of data effectively. Big data analytics also can extricate valuable information that will be used by various parties to make better decisions. To assess the success of employing big data for fault diagnosis, prevention, and restoration in the wireless network, the investigator plans to conduct a census using close ended questions from the general public.

articleTitle: A CNN-inspired Reverse Search Engine for Content-based Image Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The Reverse Search Engine enables the search and retrieval schemas of images which are visually comparable to a specific query image by utilizing the features of the images that illustrates the visual content of provided images. This contribution creates a contextual schema for recovering photographs that are indexed in distributed databases from the visual information without the requirements of linguistic annotations. We implement the generic Convolutional neural network (CNN) with deep learning strategies for retrieving feature vectors from visual information. To build the global descriptors, the pre-trained CNN architectures i.e., ResNet50, InceptionV3, and InceptionResNetV2 were recommended. These techniques outperformed in the existing methods like Metaheuristic Algorithm, Gabor Wavelet, CNN-SVM which have been compared with the proposed technique i.e., Cartoon Texture Algorithm in CBIR. We have observed that they are similar to others based on machine learning approaches, with comprising of the conventional state-of-the-art in the Content-dependent Information Retrieval.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Approach for Predicting Disease in Heart Using Logistic Regression
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The heart plays an important role in humans. The diagnosis and prediction part of the heart disease prediction process improves accuracy, completeness and accuracy in diseases where small errors can lead to fatigue problems and individual death. Heart-related deaths are numerous, counted daily, and increasing exponentially. To solve the problem, there is no way to predict disease knowledge. What is known in the field of ML provides an excellent guide for predicting all kinds of events trained from natural events. In this article, we use the UCI repository dataset for teaching and experimentation to calculate the machine learning accuracy of a cardiac disease prediction algorithm. These algorithms are k-nearest neighbors, decision trees, linear regression, and support vector devices (SVM). Anaconda (Jupiter) Notebook is a great tool for implementing Python programming. It contains various kinds of libraries and header files that make your data more accurate and unique.

articleTitle: Security Issues and Challenges in Internet of Things (IoT) System
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Significant privacy and security concerns apply to the Internet of Things. IoT issues might include driver ignorance, inadequate device updates, a lack of robust and effective safeguards, and unreliable dynamic instrument management. The study’s objectives include identifying (a) various cybersecurity concern regarding, (b) techniques for attempting to secure IoT-enabled options and buildings, (c) available at the moment security remedies, and (d) the much more acceptable privacy depictions for the differing stages of Technology apps. Researchers proposed a new, generally expanded layered paradigm that included security and privacy tools as well as layer documenting. the recommended virtualized Internet of Things system’s deployment and evaluation. Internet of Things (IoT) units built as virtualized using Amazon Web Services make the bottom layer (AWS). The topcoat was developed by researchers utilising AWS’s cloud-based IoT platform (the cloud). To allow data transfer between the envisioned cloud/edge authorised IoT representation’s levels, researchers have created ssl certificates.

articleTitle: A Microgrid’s Construction based on a Research Report using ETAP
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: It is crucial to integrate renewable sources of power like solar, batteries, and wind into the grid architecture since the grid supplies is unstable and the price of power is rising. People are more interested in micro-grid innovation because it can lower overall costs while increasing operational efficiency and functional productivity. With the aid of ETAP programming, the most thorough analytical platform for the modeling and development of power systems, the reconstruction was accomplished under a variety of conditions. To conduct simulation for various cases in conjunction with the model in ETAP program, a Micro-Grid system based on IEEE 9 bus architecture that includes a diesel engine, solar PV arrays, energy storage device, windmill, and battery bank has been constructed for further examination.

articleTitle: An Improved Accuracy in Anticipating the User Nature using a novel logistic regression algorithm throughout the pandemic across online social media based on Indian metrics over Support Vector Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This study's primary goal is to apply machine learning classifier techniques to raise the intensity percentage of user nature detection in order to detect the impact of coronavirus on Twitter users by comparing Novel Logistic Regression and Support Vector Clustering algorithms. Materials and Methods: The accuracy percentage with a confidence interval of 95% and G-power (value =0.8) was determined many times using the LR method with test size =10 and the SVC algorithm with test size =10. The likelihood that an item belongs to one category or another is predicted using a LR model. Support Vector Clustering algorithm generates a line or hyperplane that divides the data into categories. Results and Discussion: LR model has greater efficiency (91%) when compared to Support Vector Clustering (59%). Two groups are numerically unimportant, according to the data obtained with a coefficient of determination of p=0.121 ($p\gt0.05$). Conclusion: LR performs substantially better than the Support Vector Clustering.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning-Based Systems for Controlling Medical Robot Beds for Preventing Bedsores
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence is one of the most important technologies of the modern world which is continuously changing the dimensions of almost every sector. AI and IoT have together resulted in multiple outstanding technological innovations which have also impacted the healthcare sector massively. This study has critically focused on the role of AI and robotics in the treatment outcomes for patients. This study has done deep research regarding the role of automated beds in reducing pressure ulcers or bed sores among patients who are recovering from any chronic disease. This entire study has secondary qualitative data collection for analyzing the design and microcontroller systems in automated beds. This has provided a detailed data analysis with relevant equations and tables for reaching its proposed outcomes.

articleTitle: Application of Blockchain in restricting data access using AI
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Blockchain and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are two buzzwords that are now popular. Although they are mostly researched independently, blockchain and AI complement one another. For instance, a blockchain facilitates AI via the exchange and management of data. A blockchain may be used as a new platform to store and trade data as AI systems rely heavily on a lot of high-quality training data. Despite the blockchain’s extensive potential for data exchange, there isn’t a detailed review of this prospective use case at the moment. This paper seeks to fill this knowledge gap by undertaking a methodical literature review. The present techniques, their functioning, and their expected advantages are all described in this paper. Risks and unresolved scientific issues are also looked upon.

articleTitle: A Study in Understanding the Major Factors influencing the Investment Decision Making in Cryptocurrency Markets by Gen Z and Millennials
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: As a method of exchange, cryptocurrency, which is a digital version of money made possible by a system called “blockchain technology,” functions very similarly to the fiat currency that it is based on. A cryptocurrency is also referred to as payment tokens, crypto tokens, electronic money, cyber money, virtual products, and virtual assets. These are all different names for the same thing. Because of the proliferation of cryptocurrency usage, it is now feasible to engage in direct monetary transactions, so sidestepping the need for conventional monetary authorities such as banks and governments to be involved. Bitcoin was the first kind of digital currency that existed only in the online world. This is the ultimate effect of dispersing operating expenses, which is a common strategy used by financial organizations in order to maximize their revenues. Cryptography is a tried-and-tested method that may be used to protect sensitive information from being seen by unauthorized parties. When sending data via a secure encryption method, the information must first be encrypted. The name given to the decentralized peer-to-peer network that Bitcoin uses is “blockchain.” The primary objective of this change is to make it more difficult to spend money twice. The fact that neither the server nor the administration is centralized lends credence to the theory that the system in question is decentralized. Only businesses and members of the general public are able to independently validate the value of these currencies. The basic objective of the paper is to understand the major factors influencing the investment decision making in cryptocurrency markets by Gen Z and millennials. A well-structured questionnaire used for collection and convenience sampling is utilized rather commonly for the purpose of participant selection since, in comparison to other methods from a11152 participants. Despite all of the fuss, bitcoin may still be used today for genuine online transactions of items and services. articleTitle: A 38GHz mm Wave MIMO Antenna Design and Analyzed on Low Permittivity Substrate
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This paper focuses on mmWave access 38.0GHz 2-port MIMO antenna designed on Rogers RTDuroid substrate. The single-element antenna with an overall dimension of $49\mathrm{~mm}^{2}$ is designed with a circular path printed on the top plane and ground on the opposite plane providing resonance at 38.0GHz. The two-port MIMO antenna occupies a very compact size of $98\mathrm{~mm}^{2}$ with an inter-spacing of $4.00\mathrm{~mm}$ between the two-radiating elements and is useful for 5G infrastructure. The narrow-bandwidth MIMO antenna offers good matching of impedance at 38.0GHz with the optimized radius of patch $1.5275\mathrm{~mm}$. The proposed MIMO antenna radiating electromagnetic energy offers a maximum gain of 5.69dBi and radiation efficiency of 89% at $ 38.0\mathrm{GHz}\&$ stable radiation pattern. The diversity performance corresponds to $\mathrm{CCL}_{38\mathrm{GHz}}\lt 0.40\mathrm{~b}/\mathrm{s}/\mathrm{Hz}$. articleTitle: An AI Based Approach for Classification and Performance Evaluation of Teaching Assistant
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In order to test and evaluate the performance of various machine learning classifiers for teaching assistant classification, this research will use machine learning approaches. The teaching assistant dataset was taken from the Kaggle data store. After preprocessing the data to remove any inconsistencies, many supervised learning techniques were used, and their efficacy was assessed. The outcomes show that for the teaching assessment models, the ensemble technique performs better than the conventional classification techniques.

articleTitle: Time-stretching and genetic zooms in OutGene: Detecting Undefined Network Attacks
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The study introduces OutGene, a method for detecting malicious behaviour in real time without prior knowledge of assaults or training data. OutGene gathers hosts with comparable behaviour via clustering. We offer the idea of genetic zoom, which involves utilizing a genetic algorithm which select the attributes that is more pertinent to characterize cluster in order to aid human analysts in locating malevolent clusters. Attacks carried out slowly or below thresholds are frequently successful in evading machine learning-based attack detection. We offer the idea of time stretching as a way to identify such stealth attacks. The goal is to discover assaults regardless of how quickly they are carried out by analyzing the stream of events over various time frames. We evaluated OutGene experimentally using data sets currently publicly available and data sets collected at critical military installations. Both genetic zoom and temporal stretching achieved high recall and precision scores, indicating that both are effective.

articleTitle: A Brief Review of State-of-the-art Routing Methods in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Due to the widespread use in recent decades, wireless sensor networks (WSNs) have emerged as a top research area. However, the dynamic reconfiguration of WSNs offers a significant hurdle due to the fact that conventional methodologies conFigure WSNs statically. Clustering methods can be implemented in WSNs to overcome this difficulty. A plethora of researchers have proposed routing methods based on the concepts of clustering. In this paper, a brief review of state-of-the-art routing methods is presented. The focus of this work has been on the selection of Cluster Head (CH) adopted by recently proposed studies that use different optimization methods. Hence, this study will help the researchers to propose new parameters for selecting the CH that can enhance the network lifetime.

articleTitle: Predicting Student’s Mental health by Analyzing their Tweets
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Feedback systems become very common and useful in each domain of interest with the advent of the social network. Student online feedback datasets in the form of tweets are employed, and three measures: Precision, Recall, and F-Measure are used for comparative analysis. articleTitle: LTE Networks with Horizontal T-shaped Patch Antenna for Wearable Medical Devices
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)

articleTitle: Internet of Things Based Real Time Monitoring and Control of Industrial Waste Water
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In this evolving world, internet has managed to fit all our needs in a device whether it is personal computer or cell phone. Those vintage methodologies are time consuming, high-priced and not green to find out different parameter related to waste water. This calls for an actual time continuous monitoring device in each industrial outlet to reduce the danger of water infection. The focus of this proposal is to demonstrate an effective and efficient water monitoring system which will work via internet on things so that to relay the required data to administrator which will be at faraway places. The proposed method will consist of different sensors use for monitoring of parameters related to waste water in discharged water and further relay the data via controller module. The focus of this paper is to build a low-cost critical water parameters sensor network to monitor the quality of industrial waste water. As Industrial used water is the major reasons to deteriorate the water resources. This system consists of a Turbidity sensor, pH sensor, gas sensor(s), water level sensor and conductivity sensor. articleTitle: Secure and Smart Trolley Shopping System based on IoT Module

articleTitle: Image Enhancement using ESRGAN for CNN based X-Ray Classification

articleTitle: Two Dimensional Cellular Automata Encryption Method for Security
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Since the internet is today regarded as the fastest and most efficient method of transmitting signals, the privacy of signals or info is drastically decreasing. Therefore, it is essential to have a high level of privacy to hide the mysterious data. A common and effective method for protecting output information from unauthorized is encrypted. This method hides hidden data in an image using a cryptographic keys. However, it only provides a single level of protection for the data transmission. This legislation’s goal is to provide two levels of security. The first stage involves hiding information behind certain images using coded words, while the second stage involves encrypting using 2D deterministic algorithms. Employing colonial automata’s 2-D principles, decryption is completed. The surprise data is introduced into the image using the smallest bit (LSB) and Expanded Least Major But (ELSB) techniques in the first level of protection with the help of a secret word. The LSB technique was used in the dim image to encrypt the information contained in the image. In an RGB image, the data was masked using both Sb & ELSB techniques. While a ELSB technique only employs single Rgb aircraft, the LSB approach for RGB photographs uses all three vision plane. On the image in which emission data was then installed using Sb or ELSB techniques, 2D cell enary rules were implemented in the first security level. We used the 2D state machine principles 2, S, 32, and 12S to provide an extra layer of protection to data emission. Cellular Lattice rules provide increasingly complex and reliable information about the symmetric encryption. In this manner, a variety of ideas were used to get a great deal of safety. Unscrambling was done in an unparalleled manner, yet quickly after the demand.

articleTitle: Retinal blood vessel segmentation using AI
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Retinal microvascular is a dependable marker of abnormalities in vessel morphology, that have been linked to a variety of clinical disorders, both in ocular and metastatic disease. However, accurate vessel segmentation, which would be intricate- and time-intensive, is required for objective and statistical evaluation of the retinal blood vessels. In terms of segmenting retinal vessels, artificial intelligence (AI) has shown a significant amount of promise. In this study, the fundus images retinal blood vessel is segmented using deep learning methods. The data set required for this study is collected from the Kaggle website and pre-processed using various techniques to make it compatible with the deep learning models. The pre-processed images are then segmented using deep learning models such as LadderNet and UNet. The efficiency of the deep learning models are validated using performance metrics such as Intersection of Union (IoU), accuracy and F1 score. This study shows an accuracy of 0.98% using the UNet deep learning model and it is deemed to be an efficient model than the pre-existing models.

articleTitle: Evolutionary Algorithm for Enhanced Performance of Grid Connected SPV System
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This paper presents the optimized control algorithm based on the meta-heuristic approach to track the maximum power of the grid connected Solar Photovoltaic (SPV) system. Cuckoo Search Algorithm (CSA) is used for the Maximum Power Point Technique (MPPT), which utilizes a random trajectory walk according to the le’vy flight in the searching position. Synchronous Reference Frame Theory (SRFT) technique is used for Voltage Source Inverter (VSI) control. To test the efficacy of the Cuckoo Search Algorithm, performance analysis of the SPV system connected to grid for different irradiation, loading and grid voltage condition has been done. Further, proposed CSA algorithm has been compared with the Incremental Conductance (I&C) method for grid connected system. The control technique has been simulated in MATLAB 2020a / Simulink software.

articleTitle: Wireless Communication With Extreme Reliability and Low Latency: Tail, Risk and Scale
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: It is crucial to provide ultrareliable and low-latency communication (URLLC) for 5G wireless networks and above, this topic is now attracting a lot of interest in both business and academia. The fundamental requirement of URLLC is a change from conventional utility-based network design methods, where reliance on average numbers is no longer a choice but a requirement. Rather, there is a need for a comprehensive and systematic paradigm that considers factors like variability, packet size, network design, and topology. This research’s main objective is the first stage toward bridging this gap. After defining latency and dependability, we carefully explore potential URLLC enablers and the trade-offs they entail in order to go toward this objective. Then, we concentrate on a wide range of processes and approaches related to URLLC’s specifications and also how they apply to certain use cases. These findings offer clear guidance for the development of wireless networks with minimal latency and great dependability.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Different Cryptocraphy Techniques and the Role of Coding and Information Theories in Overcoming Security Threats
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In order to maintain the privacy and secrecy of information, security is essential. There are numerous encryption techniques available to safeguard data while it is being transmitted or stored. Communication security benefits greatly from encryption algorithms. These encryption strategies vary with regards to their solidarity, snappiness, and asset needs (CPU use, memory, and power). This study’s goal is to list the most famous and fascinating calculations as of now being used and to present the ideas of cryptography, cryptography in history, and modern cryptography. This investigation focused on a number of existing cryptography calculations, including DES, IDEA, 3DES, AES, ECC, RSA, homomorphic and blowfish, among others. It was determined that the RSA algorithm takes the longest amount of time to encrypt data, whereas the AES approach uses the fewest text files. We also demonstrated that the AES algorithm decryption is superior to other methods. According to the analytical findings, the AES algorithm is superior to the DES and RSA algorithms. This study recommended further developing a consolidate encipherment calculation, which joins different encipherment calculations in light of every single relevant trademark, to expand the general wellbeing and security of encipherment strategies.

articleTitle: Wireless Sensing Network’s Cyber Security Procedures: A Research
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Because WSNs (wireless sensor networks) are connected to the internet, they are an effective network for solving practical issues. A lightweight, equipment sensor with computational possibilities and limited power supplies is available in WSN as new technologies develop quickly. However, there is a significant security issue with this network. Because of the wireless communication channel, it is now challenging to guard against numerous attacks like DoS (Denial of Service). As a consequence, several different methods for identifying DoS attacks have indeed been suggested. Several indicators, including bandwidth, PDR (packet delivery ratio), and E2E (end to end) latency are calculated to assess the impact of an attack on a network. The simulations make use of real-world datasets. Even while simulations demonstrate that DoS attacks make WSNs less resilient, certain systems have been shown to be good at spotting DoS attacks.

articleTitle: Fully Automated Clustering based Blueprint for Image Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Data points are grouped together during clustering. The data points may be grouped according to comparable attributes using clustering methods. Data points are grouped using fuzzy clustering, which groups data points into one or even more clusters. Density Peak (DP) grouping may identify clusters, however as the sum of clusters is raised, memory overflow occurs because a normal-sized picture with more pixels is utilized for image segmentation, leading to a high level of similarity matrix. Automated Fuzzy Clustering Frame (AFCF) for picture segmentation might be used to prevent this. This framework offers three contributions. In order to lower the length of the similarity measure and hence increase the computational efficiency of the DP algorithm, the Density Peak approach is first employed for the idea of Super Pixel. A stable choice graph is produced by using the Density Balance approach, which also allows the DP algorithm to perform completely independent clustering. Last but not least, the system uses a Fuzzy c-means grouping based on previous entropy to enhance the results of picture segmentation. This allows for better segmentation outcomes by taking into account the data of pixels from spatial neighbors. The goal of the current study is to create and describe an Automated Fuzzy Clustering Framework for segmenting photos.

articleTitle: Energy Cost Savings in Radial Distribution System using Modified Bat Algorithm Compared with Harmony Search Algorithm by Decreasing the Real Power Loss
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This article presents a comparative study on two algorithms (Novel Modified Bat Algorithm (MBA) and Harmony Search Algorithm (HSA)) for energy cost savings by decreasing the real power loss in the radial distribution system. Materials and Methods: With the aid of DSTATCOM, a novel Modified Bat Algorithm and Harmony Search Algorithm are used to reduce real power loss in radial distribution power systems. 14 samples total were utilized in this study, and the sample size was determined using Gpower for two groups. Results: Based on the results obtained MBA produces better results than HSA in terms of energy cost savings. The significant value obtained is $0.003 (\mathrm{p}\lt 0.05$, statistically significant). Conclusion: MBA based optimization method provides significantly better energy cost savings (${\$}$34585) than HSA based method (${\$}$32765).
